data.name: Haida
data.gender_notes: Haida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘haid’, meaning ‘to guide’ or ‘to help’. In Islamic tradition, Haida is a name for a compassionate and trustworthy guide who leads one to the right path in life. The name evokes images of a wise and caring mentor, always ready to offer guidance and support. The name Haida carries the meaning “Guide, Helper, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haida usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual guide or mentor in one's life, inspiring growth, wisdom, and spiritual development.
data.etymology: Haida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Helper, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haida total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
